external_evidence.posthog: official pricing offers 1M analytics events/month free with no card required; official docs also describe freely available self-hosting; provider remains optional and no auto-spend is permitted
external_evidence.talivia: official site states 14-day trial then paid monthly pricing for founding customers; patterns only
external_evidence.microsoft_clarity: official pricing states free forever; Microsoft consent documentation requires consent signals for EEA/UK/CH full functionality from 2025-10-31; activation remains consent gated
external_evidence.yandex_metrica: official GDPR documentation describes cookie/tracking notice, data-processing agreement and IP masking; activation remains privacy/legal gated

rollback.method: revert candidate PR; Company Intent, Lead Discovery and Web Acquisition profiles remain canonical

rebuild.method: recreate from runtime contract + registry + tests + provider dispositions on current main
